subject: Q3 Renewal: capacity accelerator + temporary credit structure
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@globex.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal conversation + Q3 burst needs

Grace —

Hope you had a good 4th. We're approaching our Sept renewal with Redwood and have two asks we'd like to discuss early so procurement isn't scrambling later:

1) We expect a short-term burst in Q3 for our recommendation pipeline (roughly an additional 4M tokens peak for 8 weeks). We'd like to avoid a permanent commit bump if possible and are open to a temporary capacity accelerator (one-off credits or a time-boxed uplift).

2) Pricing stability — can you provide a 6-month price-hold on unit rates for our core embeddings and chat model while we finalize multi-year budgeting? If not a full hold, a capped step increase would work.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call next week. I've copied Priya from procurement so she can flag PO timelines.

Thanks,
Raj
Raj Patel
Director of AI Platforms, Globex Corporation
raj.patel@globex.com

Attachments: Globex_SOW_Q3-2027.pdf (stub)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@globex.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation + Q3 burst needs

Raj — thanks for the heads up and happy 4th to you as well. This is exactly the kind of timing where we can be flexible. Quick summary of what we can propose off the bat:

- Q3 capacity accelerator: time-boxed credits applied to the 8-week window (we can model this as a one-time credit draw tied to usage, up to a pre-agreed cap).
- 6-month price-hold: we can offer a price-hold on the core chat unit rate provided the renewal includes either a 6- or 12-month committed spend minimum. If you prefer no commit increase, we can do a shorter hold (3 months) + a capped step increase thereafter.

I'm looping in Ben to share a concrete worksheet and a quick pricing matrix (credits vs. short-term uplift vs. commit). Ben — can you prepare the worksheet and a two-option term sheet (Option A: 6-month hold with small uplift commit; Option B: credit-based Q3 accelerator + 3-month hold)?

If you and Priya are available, I'm free Mon 7/5 10–11am PT or Tue 7/6 9–11am PT.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Renewals, Redwood Inference
grace@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@globex.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal conversation + Q3 burst needs — pricing worksheet attached

Hi all —

Attached is a compact worksheet (redwood-price-worksheet.xlsx) with two modeled paths, plus a conservative forecast for the 8-week burst. Highlights:

- Option A (Commit + 6-month hold): commit increase of 25% on current monthly committed tokens, 6-month flat unit pricing. Includes a 5% loyalty discount applied on top of list rates for the term.

- Option B (Credits + 3-month hold): one-time Q3 credit bucket equivalent to ~2.5M tokens (drawn as usage credits). Price-hold for 3 months on core units, capped step increase of up to 7% after that. No commit increase required.

- For both options we can include a limited 'burst protection' clause that allows an emergency rate cap if usage exceeds modeled peak (triggers: 2x forecasted peak). That clause requires a short exec sign-off.

Next steps I recommend: 1) review worksheet, 2) Grace + Raj to decide which option to present to finance, 3) if Option A chosen, legal will prep an amendment; if Option B, we send a short SOW + credit schedule.

I've attached the worksheet and a quick one-page summary as PDFs (see attachments). Happy to walk through on call.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Renewal conversation + Q3 burst needs — finalizing Option B and next steps

Thanks team — following our call this morning, we're aligned on Option B (credit-based Q3 accelerator + 3-month hold). Summary of agreed commercial points below (confirming in writing):

- Q3 Credit Bucket: Globex will receive a one-time credit of 2.75M token-equivalent usable between 2027-08-01 and 2027-09-30. Unused credits expire after 2027-09-30 and are non-transferable.
- Price-hold: unit rates for chat and embeddings will be held at current rates through 2027-11-30 (3 months after Q3).
- Post-hold: capped step increase up to 7% starting 2027-12-01 unless a new multi-year agreement is signed.
- Billing & PO: Redwood to accept Globex PO against the SOW; credits will be invoiced as a single line item and drawn down against usage.
- Legal: short SOW and credit schedule to be issued; credits explicitly non-recurring.

I've uploaded the short SOW and routed a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEFG-Globex-DEAL-GLX-721
HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-GLX-721

Next actions for us:
1) Priya — confirm PO number and remit to finance once DocuSign is complete (target: 7/9).
2) Ben — finalize SOW and attach the credit schedule to DocuSign (please include the price worksheet in the attachment list).
3) Vivek — coordinate CS onboarding for Q3 burst (KV cache warmup, pre-warm batches, and monitoring runbook).

If everyone confirms here I'll ask Legal to lock the amendment and match the DocuSign package to the PO.

Thanks — appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
